prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic close-up on 35mm film, night, inside a UK ambulance. Looking down at two blue-gloved hands, one laid over the other, resting still on the centre of an older man's chest over a thin pale gown, the pushing finished. At the top of the frame, his grey chin and the edge of a clear oxygen mask. One side of the frame is washed green by the glow of a heart monitor's flat line, reflecting off the gloves and skin; a slow band of blue emergency light falls across from a rain-streaked window. The black stretcher mattress and a loose strap fill the bottom of the frame. Hard cold overhead light, deep shadow, real grain, slightly underexposed. Quiet and devastating, not gory. Thanks.
